Container.Name: trackseerr
Container.Overview:
TrackSeerr is a self-hosted, multi-user music request, discovery, and library management suite combining an Overseerr-style frontend with an Arr-style media management and acquisition backend. Works with Plex, Jellyfin, Subsonic servers (Navidrome, Gonic, Airsonic), or no media server.
Key Capabilities: - Music Discovery & Audio Previews: Zero-key discovery of trending charts, new releases, and deep search via public Apple Music and Deezer APIs with 30-second audio previews. - Multi-User Request Engine: Plex Home user integration, per-user request quotas, and administrative approval queues. - Dual Acquisition Engine: Fulfill requests using your existing Lidarr server via batched trickle automation, or use native acquisition drivers (slskd / Soulseek P2P for single-track and album surgical matching, SABnzbd for Usenet, qBittorrent for torrents, Torznab/Newznab indexers). - Real-Time Activity Queue: Live transfer progress, speed monitoring, cancellation, and retry controls. - Arr-Grade Media Management: Mutagen audio inspection, token template naming engine ({Artist Name}/{Album Title} ({Release Year})/{track:00} - {Track Title}), collision protection, and automated media server library refresh pings. - Playlist Synchronization: Import and synchronize Spotify and Deezer playlists directly into personal profiles with keyless scraping and 1-click browser bookmarklets. - Two-Tier DMZ Option: split into TrackSeerr Requests (public, stateless) and TrackSeerr Core (internal) for exposure behind reverse proxies and Cloudflare Tunnels.
Exposing to the internet? Use TrackSeerr Core + TrackSeerr Requests instead (two separate templates). The public container then holds no Plex token, no downloader credentials and no volumes.
This all-in-one template is intended for LAN, VPN and Tailscale use. Moving to the split setup later only means changing this container to ROLE=core (same appdata, no data migration) and adding TrackSeerr Requests.
Note: Lidarr automation, media server settings, download clients, indexers, media management paths, quotas, and Application URL are configured dynamically in the WebUI Settings.

Config.Name: WebUI & API Port
Config.Description: Web Dashboard and REST API port. Accessible in your browser.

Config.Name: Application URL
Config.Description: The public URL used to reach TrackSeerr from outside your network (e.g. https://trackseerr.yourdomain.com). Used for notification links, Plex OAuth redirects and proxy routing. Exposing to the internet? Use TrackSeerr Core + TrackSeerr Requests instead.

Config.Name: AppData Storage
Config.Description: Persistent configuration directory for the SQLite database, sessions, and logs.

Config.Name: Data Storage (TRaSH Guides)
Config.Description: Unified host data share containing both library (/data/media/music) and download staging (/data/downloads) on a single filesystem to enable instant atomic moves and hardlinks.

Config.Name: Execution Role
Config.Description: Leave as all-in-one for LAN/VPN use. To split for internet exposure, use the TrackSeerr Core and TrackSeerr Requests templates (core/gateway); do not hand-edit unless migrating.

Config.Name: Internal Core Secret
Config.Description: Only used in split mode (ROLE=core). Leave blank for all-in-one.

Config.Name: Media Server
Config.Description: plex, jellyfin, subsonic or none. Leave empty to use Plex when Plex URL and token are set, or to choose in Settings > Media Management > Media Server.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Creates the first local admin (user 'admin') when there is no Plex server to sign in with. At least 12 characters. Only used on first start.

Config.Name: Plex Server URL
Config.Description: Plex only. Set together with Plex Token, or leave both empty. Use the LAN IP, not localhost.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Plex only. Set together with Plex Server URL, or leave both empty.

Config.Name: Plex Music Library Section
Config.Description: Name of the Plex music library to use. Leave empty to use the first music library.

Config.Name: Plex Machine Identifier
Config.Description: Plex server machine identifier for multi-user access pinning. Leave blank to auto-detect.

Config.Name: Plex SSL Verification
Config.Description: Set to 0 if your Plex Media Server uses a self-signed certificate without valid chain.

Config.Name: Jellyfin Server URL
Config.Description: Jellyfin base URL. Requires MEDIA_SERVER=jellyfin. Can be configured in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: Jellyfin API Key
Config.Description: Jellyfin API key. Requires MEDIA_SERVER=jellyfin. Can be configured in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: Subsonic Server URL
Config.Description: Subsonic base URL. Requires MEDIA_SERVER=subsonic. Can be configured in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: Subsonic Username
Config.Description: Subsonic username. Requires MEDIA_SERVER=subsonic. Can be configured in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: Subsonic Password
Config.Description: Subsonic password. Requires MEDIA_SERVER=subsonic. Can be configured in the web UI instead.

Config.Name: Feed Access Token
Config.Description: Optional: Secret token to protect RSS feeds, plain text lists, and webhook endpoints if exposed to untrusted networks.

Config.Name: Sync Interval (Seconds)
Config.Description: Duration in seconds between automated background sync cycles (default 14400 = 4 hours).

Config.Name: User ID (PUID)
Config.Description: Unraid nobody user ID for file permission compatibility.

Config.Name: Group ID (PGID)
Config.Description: Unraid users group ID for file permission compatibility.

Config.Name: Umask
Config.Description: Standard umask permissions for created files.
